In the rest frame of the glass, the light speed along the beam is

\[
u'=\frac{1}{n}.
\]

The glass moves at speed \(v\) in the same direction relative to the lab, so use relativistic velocity addition:

\[
u=\frac{u'+v}{1+u'v}
=\frac{\frac1n+v}{1+\frac{v}{n}}
=\frac{1+nv}{n+v}.
\]

This matches option (D).

Answer: D
